claims.summary: The release targets the fresh deployed v0.15.104 UX audit where source/export/report truth was clean and the remaining score loss was Texture 92.
Assignment Brief support resources rotate six lesson-specific packet shapes instead of repeating the same notes/readings, rubric, checklist, and office-hours tail.
Parameter-derived Rubric rows rotate evidence signals, calibration prompts, feedback moves, and performance bands without changing brief fidelity criteria or weights.
Rubric task directions and instructor-preference notes vary their evidence-standard and feedback-emphasis frames while preserving criteria, weights, and source boundaries.
Lesson Plan mini-lessons with authored kernel facts rotate the anchor-fact transfer sentence instead of repeating the same reuse frame across the course.
